content.value: In a certain city, if today is sunny, tomorrow will be sunny 70% of the time. If today is (10) cloudy, tomorrow will be cloudy 60% of the time. Suppose, today is Friday and the weather is cloudy. What is the probability that the weather will be sunny on Tuesday?

Patients arrive at a 1-docter clinic according to a Poisson distribution at the rate of 15 (15) patients per hour. The waiting -room does not accommodate more than 10 patients. Examination time per patient is exponentiai with mean rate 12 per hour
(i) Find the effective arrival rate at the clinic.
(ii) What is the probability that an arriving patient will get service immediately?
(iii) What is the expected total time a patient spends in the clinic?
